title: mobile-check-in-attendee-listing.html
content: App Prerequisite To use the QR code scan feature, the Mobile Check-in app must be updated to Version 1.0.10 or higher. Check-in Options QR Code To check in an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} using the {{variable.Feature_QRCode}} scan feature press the capture a QR code button on the home screen and scan the {{variable.Feature_QRCode}} . A valid {{variable.Feature_QRCode}} will start the check-in process and provide the user with relevant details about the {{variable.Object_Event}} . If you are using an iOS device and need to close the QR code scanning feature without scanning a QR code, click the Cancel button. Attendee Name Select an {{variable.Object_Event}} from the Event listing screen. On the Attendee listing screen, you can see the registered {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s for the {{variable.Object_Event}} . There is a refresh button on the top right for manually refreshing the list in case there are data changes from Salesforce. Also, the sub-header displays the total checked-in {{variable.Object_Attendee}} count as well as total registered {{variable.Object_Attendee}} count. To check someone in, swipe their name from right to left, or tap their name to see their {{variable.Object_Attendee}} details and check them in from there. The Attendee is now checked in. Attendee Badge To check someone in using their badge {{variable.Feature_QRCode}} , tap the floating scan button to trigger the camera like so: Once a {{variable.Feature_QRCode}} is accepted and found, you will be taken to the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} details screen, otherwise, an alert message will be prompted saying no one is found. Review the Check-in History To review the check-in history for an Event’s Attendees, complete the following steps. Go to the Event. Tap the Attendees tab.  Click the three dots in the top right corner. Click Check In History .
